title: Nourishing Smoky Ukrainian Malai Kebabs
description: A jammy, velvety, lazy-sunday Ukrainian dish featuring malai, with a smoky flavor, made paleo-friendly and served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the malai, ground beef, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until just combined.
Thread the mixture onto skewers, if using, or shape into small patties.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and let them smoke for 5 minutes.
Place the kebabs or patties on the cedar planks and close the grill lid.
Cook for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the kebabs are cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
